Diagnostic Architecture

Specialist Diagnostic Architecture

Our compliance engine routes inquiries across statutory, diagnostic, hygiene, and emergency make-safe disciplines.

DISCIPLINE 01 · STATUTORY

WHS Standards Statutory Auditor

Audits s425 Asbestos Registers and s429 Management Plans against Queensland Code of Practice 2021 standards.

DISCIPLINE 02 · HYGIENE

NATA Lab Sample Triage

Interprets Polarised Light Microscopy (PLM) reports, fiber counts (<0.01 fibers/mL), and clearance certificates.

DISCIPLINE 03 · ESTIMATION

Hazard Cost & Scope Estimator

Generates fixed estimates per m² for bonded and Class A friable asbestos removal and HEPA negative-air containment.

DISCIPLINE 04 · EMERGENCY

24/7 Make-Safe Dispatcher

Immediately prioritizes storm damage, collapsed ceiling materials, and water ingress emergencies across SEQ.

DISCIPLINE 05 · STRUCTURAL

Building Defect & Ingress Auditor

Analyzes concrete spalling, membrane failure, timber rot, and foundation movement against Australian Standards.

DISCIPLINE 06 · LEGAL

PCBU Indemnity Guardian

Ensures property managers and body corporate committees maintain legally defensible records with zero gap liability.
